# iTop Pools

> Authorized Barrier Reef Pools USA fiberglass dealer in Jacksonville, Florida. One in-house crew handles the pool, deck and pavers, with permits and HOA handled. Free 3D design and site visit.

iTop Pools
6510 Columbia Park Drive, Suite 206, Jacksonville, FL 32258
(904) 685-2555
hello@itoppools.com
Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Service area: Jacksonville, FL; Ponte Vedra Beach, FL; St. Johns, FL; Orange Park, FL; Fleming Island, FL; Nocatee, FL; Julington Creek, FL; Mandarin, FL; Jacksonville Beach, FL; St. Augustine, FL; Green Cove Springs, FL; Middleburg, FL.

## Key facts
- Warranty: Barrier Reef Lifetime Limited Structural Warranty, transferable once; 15-year finish warranty against blistering
- Install time: Barrier Reef puts a typical install at 2–6 weeks once permits clear
- 22 Barrier Reef models, from 16'6" to 40' long
